paragraphs: HEICO Corporation through its subsidiaries (collectively, "HEICO," "we," "us," "our" or the "Company") believes it is the world's largest manufacturer of Federal Aviation Administration ("FAA")-approved jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts, other than the original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") and their subcontractors. HEICO also believes it is a leading manufacturer of various types of electronic equipment for the aviation, defense, space, medical, telecommunications and electronics industries.

The Company was originally organized in 1957 as a holding company known as HEICO Corporation. As part of a reorganization completed in 1993, the original holding company (formerly known as HEICO Corporation) was renamed as HEICO Aerospace Corporation and a new holding corporation known as HEICO Corporation was created. The reorganization did not result in any change in the business of the Company, its consolidated assets or liabilities or the relative interests of its shareholders.
Our business is comprised of two operating segments:

The Flight Support Group. Our Flight Support Group ("FSG"), consisting of HEICO Aerospace Holdings Corp. and HEICO Flight Support Corp. and their collective subsidiaries, accounted for 70%, 68% and 60% of our net sales in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. The FSG uses proprietary technology to design and manufacture jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts for sale at lower prices than those manufactured by OEMs. These parts are approved by the FAA and are the functional equivalent of parts sold by OEMs. In addition, the FSG repairs, overhauls and distributes jet engine and aircraft components, avionics and instruments for domestic and foreign commercial air carriers and aircraft repair companies as well as military and business aircraft operators. The FSG also manufactures and sells specialty parts as a subcontractor for aerospace and industrial original equipment manufacturers and the United States ("U.S.") government. Additionally, the FSG is a leading supplier, distributor, and integrator of military aircraft parts and support services primarily to the U.S. Department of Defense, defense prime contractors, and foreign military organizations allied with the U.S. Further, the FSG is a leading manufacturer of advanced niche components and complex composite assemblies for commercial aviation, defense and space applications. The FSG also engineers, designs and manufactures thermal insulation blankets and parts as well as removable/reusable insulation systems for aerospace, defense, commercial and industrial applications; manufactures expanded foil mesh for lightning strike protection in fixed and rotary wing aircraft; distributes aviation electrical interconnect products and electromechanical parts; overhauls industrial pumps, motors, and other hydraulic units with a focus on the support of legacy systems for the U.S. Navy; performs tight-tolerance machining, brazing, fabricating and welding services for aerospace, defense and other industrial applications; and manufactures emergency descent devices ("EDDs") and personnel and cargo parachute products.

The Electronic Technologies Group. Our Electronic Technologies Group ("ETG"), consisting of HEICO Electronic Technologies Corp. and its subsidiaries, accounted for 30%, 32% and 40% of our net sales in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. The ETG derived approximately 51%, 51% and 49% of its net sales in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively, from the sale of products and services to U.S. and foreign military agencies, prime defense contractors and both commercial and defense satellite and spacecraft manufacturers. The ETG collectively designs, manufactures and sells various types of electronic, data and microwave, and electro-optical products, including infrared simulation and test equipment, laser rangefinder receivers, electrical power supplies, back-up power supplies, power conversion products, underwater locator beacons, emergency locator transmission beacons, flight deck annunciators, panels, indicators, electromagnetic and radio frequency interference shielding and filters, high power capacitor charging power supplies, amplifiers, traveling wave tube amplifiers, photodetectors, amplifier modules, microwave power modules, flash lamp drivers, laser diode drivers, arc lamp power supplies, custom power supply designs, cable assemblies, high voltage power supplies, high voltage interconnection devices and wire, high voltage energy generators, high frequency power delivery systems; memory products, including three-dimensional microelectronic and stacked memory, static random-access memory (SRAM), and electronically erasable programmable read-only memory (EEPROM); harsh environment electronic connectors and other interconnect products, radio frequency ("RF") and microwave amplifiers, transmitters, and receivers and integrated assemblies, sub-assemblies and components; RF sources, detectors and controllers, wireless cabin control systems, solid state power distribution and management systems, proprietary in-cabin power and entertainment components and subsystems, cockpit displays and other avionics components, crashworthy and ballistically self-sealing auxiliary fuel systems, nuclear radiation detectors, communications and electronic intercept receivers and tuners, fuel level sensing systems, high-speed interface products that link devices, high performance active antenna systems and airborne antennas for commercial and military aircraft, precision guided munitions, other defense applications and commercial uses; silicone material for a variety of demanding applications; precision power analog monolithic, hybrid and open frame components; high-reliability ceramic-to-metal feedthroughs and connectors, technical surveillance countermeasures (TSCM) equipment to detect devices used for espionage and information theft; rugged small-form factor embedded computing solutions; custom high power filters and filter assemblies; test sockets and adapters for both engineering and production use of semiconductor devices; radiation assurance services and products; and high reliability ("Hi-Rel"), complex, passive electronic components and rotary joint assemblies for mostly aerospace and defense applications, in addition to other high-end applications, such as medical and energy uses, including emerging "clean energy" and electrification applications.

HEICO has continuously operated in the aerospace industry for over 65 years. Since assuming control in 1990, our current management has achieved significant sales and profit growth through a broadened line of product offerings, an expanded customer base, increased research and development expenditures and the completion of many acquisitions. As a result of internal growth and acquisitions, our net sales from continuing operations have grown from $26.2 million in fiscal 1990 to $4,485.0 million in fiscal 2025, representing a compound annual growth rate of approximately 16%. During the same period, we improved our net income from
$2.0 million to $690.4 million, representing a compound annual growth rate of approximately 18%.

Acquisitions have been an important element of our growth strategy over the past thirty-five years, supplementing our organic growth. Since 1990, we have completed approximately 107 acquisitions complementing the niche segments of the aviation, defense, space, medical, telecommunications and electronics industries in which we operate. We typically target acquisition opportunities that allow us to broaden our product offerings, services and technologies while expanding our customer base and geographic presence. Even though we have historically pursued an active acquisition policy, our disciplined acquisition strategy involves limiting acquisition candidates to businesses that we believe will continue to grow, offer strong cash flow and earnings potential, and are available at fair prices. See Note 2, Acquisitions, of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for further information regarding our recent acquisitions.

The Flight Support Group serves a broad spectrum of the aviation industry, including (i) commercial airlines and air cargo carriers; (ii) repair and overhaul facilities; (iii) OEMs; and (iv) U.S. and foreign governments.

The FSG competes with the leading industry OEMs and, to a lesser extent, with a number of smaller, independent parts distributors. Historically, the three principal jet engine OEMs, General Electric (including CFM International), Pratt & Whitney and Rolls Royce, have been the sole source of substantially all jet engine replacement parts for their jet engines. Other OEMs have been the sole source of replacement parts for their aircraft component parts. We believe that we are the largest independent supplier of non-OEM jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts, and in recent years and inclusive of acquisitions, we are now adding new products to our line at a rate of approximately 400 to 550 Parts Manufacturer Approvals ("PMA" or "PMAs") per year. We have developed for our customers approximately 20,000 parts for which PMAs have been received from the FAA.

Jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts can be categorized by their ongoing ability to be repaired and returned to service. The general categories in which we participate are as follows: (i) rotable; (ii) repairable; and (iii) expendable. A rotable is a part which is removed periodically as dictated by an operator's maintenance procedures or on an as needed basis and is typically repaired or overhauled and re-used an indefinite number of times. An important subset of rotables is "life-limited" parts. A life-limited rotable has a designated number of allowable flight hours and/or cycles (one take-off and landing generally constitutes one cycle) after which it is rendered unusable. A repairable is similar to a rotable except that it can only be repaired a limited number of times before it must be discarded. An expendable is generally a part which is used up and replaced as opposed to being repaired for further use.

Jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts are classified within the industry as (i) factory-new; (ii) new surplus; (iii) overhauled; (iv) repairable; and (v) as removed. A factory-new or new surplus part is one that has never been installed or used. Factory-new parts are purchased from FAA-approved manufacturers (such as HEICO or OEMs) or their authorized distributors. New surplus parts are purchased from excess stock of airlines, repair facilities or other redistributors. An overhauled part is one that has been completely repaired and inspected by a licensed repair facility such as ours. An aircraft spare part is classified as "repairable" if it can be repaired by a licensed repair facility under applicable regulations. A part may also be classified as "repairable" if it can be removed by the operator from an aircraft or jet engine while operating under an approved maintenance program and is airworthy and meets any manufacturer or time and cycle restrictions applicable to the part. A "factory-new," "new surplus" or "overhauled" part designation indicates that the part can be immediately utilized on an aircraft. A part in "as removed" or "repairable" condition requires inspection and possibly functional testing, repair or overhaul by a licensed facility prior to being returned to service in an aircraft.

FAA Approvals and Product Design. Non-OEM manufacturers of jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts must receive a PMA from the FAA to sell the replacement part. The PMA approval process includes the submission of sample parts, drawings and testing data to one of the FAA's Aircraft Certification Offices where the submitted data are analyzed. We believe that an applicant's ability to successfully complete the PMA process is limited by several factors, including (i) the agency's confidence level in the applicant; (ii) the complexity of the part; (iii) the volume of PMAs being filed; and (iv) the resources available to the FAA. We also believe that companies such as HEICO that have demonstrated their advanced design engineering and manufacturing capabilities, including an established favorable track record with the FAA, generally receive a faster turnaround time in the processing of PMA applications. Finally, we believe that the PMA process creates a significant barrier to entry in this market niche through both its technical demands and its limits on the rate at which competitors can bring products to market.

Factory-New Jet Engine and Aircraft Component Replacement Parts. The FSG engages in the research and development, design, manufacture and sale of FAA-approved replacement parts that are sold to domestic and foreign commercial air carriers and aircraft repair and overhaul companies. Our principal competitors are aircraft engine and aircraft component manufacturers. The FSG's factory-new replacement parts include various jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts. A key element of our growth strategy is the continued design and development of an increasing number of PMA replacement parts in order to further penetrate our existing customer base and obtain new customers. We select the jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts to design and manufacture through a selection process which analyzes industry information to determine which replacement parts are suitable candidates.

paragraphs: HEICO Corporation 透過其子公司（合稱為 "HEICO," "we," "us," "our" 或 the "Company") 認為其為全球最大的 FAA（"美國聯邦航空管理局"）認可的噴射引擎及飛機零組件更換零件製造商，不包含原廠設備製造商（"OEMs"）及其 subcontractors。HEICO 也認為其為航空、防衛、太空、醫療、電信及電子產業各種類型電子設備的領導製造商。
本公司於 1957 年最初成立為一家控股公司，名為 HEICO Corporation。在 1993 年完成一項重組後，原控股公司（當時稱為 HEICO Corporation）更名為 HEICO Aerospace Corporation，並成立一家新的控股公司，名為 HEICO Corporation。此重組未導致本公司業務、合併資產或負債或股東權益的任何變動。
本公司業務包含兩個營運分部：

飛行支援組。本公司飛行支援組（"FSG"），包含 HEICO Aerospace Holdings Corp. 及 HEICO Flight Support Corp. 以及其所有子公司，於財務年度 2025、2024 及 2023 的淨銷售額分別佔本公司淨銷售額的 70%、68% 及 60%。FSG 使用專有技術設計及製造噴射引擎及飛機零組件更換零件，銷售價格低於原廠設備製造商（"OEMs"）所製造的零件。這些零件已獲得 FAA 認可，且功能與原廠設備製造商所銷售的零件相同。此外，FSG 會進行噴射引擎及飛機零組件、飛航電子設備及儀器的維修、翻新及分銷，服務於國內外商業航空公司及飛機維修公司，以及軍事及商務飛機操作者。FSG 也會作為航空及工業原廠設備製造商及美國（"U.S.") 政府的 subcontractor，製造及銷售專業零件。此外，FSG 是軍用飛機零件及支援服務的主要供應商、分銷商及整合商，主要服務美國國防部、防衛主承包商及與美國結盟的外國軍事機構。進一步地，FSG 是商業航空、防衛及太空應用的先進專業零組件及複雜複合組裝的主要製造商。FSG 也會設計、製造及銷售熱絕緣毯及零件，以及可移除/可重複使用的絕緣系統，應用於航空、防衛、商業及工業領域；製造擴展金屬網，用於固定翼及旋翼飛機的雷擊保護；分銷航空電氣連接產品及電機機械零件；翻新工業泵、馬達及其他液壓單元，專注於美國海軍的遺留系統支援；執行精密公差機械加工、焊接、焊接及焊接服務，應用於航空、防衛及其他工業領域；並製造緊急下降裝置（"EDDs"）及人員與貨物降落傘產品。

電子科技組。本公司電子科技組（"ETG"），包含 HEICO Electronic Technologies Corp. 及其子公司，於財務年度 2025、2024 及 2023 的淨銷售額分別佔本公司淨銷售額的 30%、32% 及 40%。ETG 在財務年度 2025、2024 及 2023 的淨銷售額中，約有 51%、51% 及 49% 來自向美國及外國軍事機構、防衛主承包商及商業與防衛衛星及太空飛行器製造商銷售產品與服務。ETG 集中設計、製造及銷售各種類型的電子、數據及微波、電光產品，包括紅外線模擬與測試設備、雷射測距接收器、電氣電源供應器、備用電源供應器、電力轉換產品、水下定位信標、緊急定位傳輸信標、飛行甲板訊息顯示器、面板、指示器、電磁及無線電頻率幹擾屏蔽與濾波器、高功率電容器充電電源供應器、放大器、行波管放大器、光電探測器、放大器模組、微波功率模組、閃爍燈驅動器、雷射二極體驅動器、弧光燈電源供應器、客製化電源供應設計、電纜組裝、高壓電源供應器、高壓連接裝置及電線、高壓能量產生器、高頻電力傳輸系統；記憶體產品，包括三維微電子及堆疊記憶體、靜態隨機存取記憶體（SRAM）及電子可擦除可程式化只讀記憶體（EEPROM）；嚴苛環境電子連接器及其他連接產品、無線電頻率（"RF"）及微波放大器、發射器及接收器及整合組裝、子組裝及零件；RF 來源、探測器及控制器、無線客艙控制系統、固態電力分配與管理系統、專有客艙電力與娛樂元件及子系統、駕駛艙顯示器及其他飛航電子元件、抗撞及彈道自密封輔助燃料系統、核子輻射探測器、通訊及電子截獲接收器及調諧器、燃料水平感測系統、高速介面產品，用於連接裝置、高性能主動天線系統及空中天線，用於商業及軍事飛機、精準導引彈藥及其他防衛應用及商業用途；用於各種嚴苛應用的矽膠材料；精密電力類比單晶、混合及開放框架元件；高可靠性陶瓷至金屬穿通件及連接器、技術監察反制措施（TSCM）設備，用於偵測間諜及資訊竊取設備；堅固的小型嵌入式計算解決方案；客製高功率濾波器及濾波器組裝；用於半導體裝置工程及生產的測試插座及適配器；輻射保障服務及產品；以及高可靠性（"Hi-Rel"）、複雜、被動電子元件及旋轉接頭組裝，主要應用於航空及防衛領域，以及其他高階應用，如醫療及能源用途，包括新興 "潔淨能源" 及電動化應用。
HEICO 已連續在航空產業運作超過 65 年。自 1990 年取得控制權後，本公司現任管理階層透過擴展產品線、擴大客戶羣、增加研究與開發支出及完成許多收購，實現了顯著的銷售與利潤成長。由於內部成長及收購，本公司持續營運的淨銷售額從財務年度 1990 年的 2,620 萬美元成長至財務年度 2025 年的 4,485,000 萬美元，年複合成長率約為 16%。在相同期間，本公司淨利潤從
$2,000 萬美元成長至 $690,400 萬美元，年複合成長率約為 18%。

收購一直是本公司過去 35 年成長策略的重要組成部分，補足本公司內生成長。自 1990 年以來，本公司已完成約 107 項收購，補足航空、防衛、太空、醫療、電信及電子產業中我們經營的專業領域。我們通常尋找能讓我們擴展產品線、服務及技術，同時擴大客戶羣及地理存在的收購機會。儘管我們歷來積極追求收購政策，但我們的嚴謹收購策略涉及限制收購候選對象為我們認為將持續成長、提供強勁現金流及獲利潛力，且價格公平的企業。有關我們最近收購的進一步資訊，請參閱財務明細附註第 2 項 "收購"。
Flight Support Group 服務航空產業廣泛的範疇，包括 (i) 商用航空公司及貨運航空業者；(ii) 修復與大修設施；(iii) 原廠製造商；以及 (iv) 美國與外國政府。

FSG 與主要的產業原廠製造商競爭，且在較小程度上與數家較小的獨立零組件經銷商競爭。歷史上，三大主要噴氣引擎原廠製造商 General Electric（包括 CFM International）、Pratt & Whitney 及 Rolls Royce，為其噴氣引擎提供幾乎所有更換零組件。其他原廠製造商則為其飛機零組件提供獨家更換零組件。我們認為本公司為最大的獨立供應商，提供非原廠製造商噴氣引擎及飛機零組件更換零組件，且近年來（包含併購）我們每年新增至約 400 到 550 個零件製造商認證（"PMA" 或 "PMAs"）。我們為客戶開發了約 20,000 個零件，並已獲得 FAA 的 PMA 認證。

噴氣引擎及飛機零組件更換零組件可根據其持續修復並重返服務的能力建立分類。我們參與的總體分類如下：(i) 可重複使用零件；(ii) 可修復零件；以及 (iii) 一次性使用零件。可重複使用零件為根據運營者維護程序定期移除或按需移除的零件，通常會被修復或大修後重複使用無限次數。可重複使用零件的重要子集為 "壽命限制" 零件。壽命限制可重複使用零件有指定的使用飛行小時數及/或循環數（一般一次起降為一個循環），達到此數值後即無法使用。可修復零件與可重複使用零件類似，但只能被修復有限次數後必須棄置。一次性使用零件通常為使用後即被更換，而非修復後再次使用。

噴氣引擎及飛機零組件更換零組件在產業中被分為 (i) 原廠全新；(ii) 新進庫存；(iii) 大修過；(4) 可修復；以及 (v) 作為移除。原廠全新或新進庫存零件為從未安裝或使用過的零件。原廠全新零件從 FAA 認可的製造商（如 HEICO 或原廠製造商）或其授權經銷商處購入。新進庫存零件則從航空公司、修復設施或其他再分配商的過剩庫存購入。大修過零件為經由經認可的修復設施（如本公司）完全修復並檢查過的零件。飛機備用零件被歸類為 "可修復"，若其可由經認可的修復設施根據適用的法規進行修復。零件也可能被歸類為 "可修復"，若其可由運營者從飛機或噴氣引擎中移除，並在符合批准的維護計劃下運作，且為飛行安全且符合製造商或時間與循環限制。"原廠全新"、"新進庫存" 或 "大修過" 的零件標示表示該零件可立即用於飛機。"作為移除" 或 "可修復" 狀態的零件需經由經認可的設施進行檢查及可能的功能測試、修復或大修後，才能重返飛機服務。

FAA 認證與產品設計。非原廠製造商的噴氣引擎及飛機零組件更換零件必須獲得 FAA 的 PMA 認證才能銷售該更換零件。PMA 認證程序包括向 FAA 的飛機認證辦公室提交樣品零件、圖紙及測試數據，並進行分析。我們認為申請人成功完成 PMA 程序的能力受到多個因素限制，包括 (i) 申請人與機構的信譽；(ii) 零件的複雜度；(iii) 提交的 PMA 數量；以及 (iv) FAA 可用的資源。我們也認為像 HEICO 這樣的公司，因其展示出先進的設計工程與製造能力，包括與 FAA 的良好歷史紀錄，通常會在 PMA 申請處理上獲得較快的處理時間。最後，我們認為 PMA 程序透過其技術要求及對競爭者產品上市速度的限制，為此市場細分建立了顯著的進入門檻。

原廠全新噴氣引擎及飛機零組件更換零件。FSG 進行 FAA 認可的更換零件之研究與開發、設計、製造與銷售，銷售對象為國內外的商業航空運輸業者及飛機修復與大修公司。我們的主要競爭對手為飛機引擎及飛機零組件製造商。FSG 的原廠全新更換零件包括各種噴氣引擎及飛機零組件更換零件。我們成長策略的關鍵要素為持續設計與開發更多 PMA 更換零件，以進一步深入現有客戶羣並獲得新客戶。我們透過分析產業資訊的選取程序，選擇要設計與製造的噴氣引擎及飛機零組件更換零件。

paragraphs: 本公司業務包含兩個營運分部，即飛行支援組（"FSG"）與電子科技組（"ETG"）。
飛行支援組（"FSG"）包含 HEICO Aerospace Holdings Corp.（"HEICO Aerospace"），為本公司持有 80% 股權，以及 HEICO Flight Support Corp.，為本公司持有 100% 股權，以及其合併子公司，其主要業務為：

•設計、製造、維修、翻修與分銷噴射引擎與飛機零組件更換零件。飛行支援組（"FSG"）設計與製造經美國聯邦航空管理局（"FAA"）認可的噴射引擎與飛機零組件更換零件。此外，飛行支援組（"FSG"）亦維修、翻修與分銷噴射引擎與飛機零組件、航電與儀器，服務於國內外商業航空業者與飛機維修公司，以及軍用與商務飛機操作者。飛行支援組（"FSG"）亦作為航空航天與工業原廠設備製造商以及美國（"U.S."）政府的 subcontractor，製造與銷售專用零件。此外，飛行支援組（"FSG"）為美國國防部、防禦主承包商與與美國結盟的外國軍事組織，提供主要的軍用飛機零件與支援服務供應商、分銷商與整合商。進一步而言，飛行支援組（"FSG"）亦為商業航空、防禦與太空應用領域的先進專業零組件與複雜複合組件製造商。飛行支援組（"FSG"）亦工程設計與製造熱絕緣毯與零件，以及可移除/可重複使用的絕緣系統，應用於航空航天、防禦、商業與工業領域；製造擴展金屬網，用於固定翼與旋翼飛機的雷擊保護；分銷航空電氣連接產品與電機機械零件；翻修工業泵、馬達與其他液壓單元，專注於支持美國海軍的過時系統；執行高精度機械加工、焊錫、製造與焊接服務，應用於航空航天、防禦及其他工業領域；並製造緊急下降裝置（"EDDs"）與人員與貨物降落傘產品。
電子科技組（"ETG"）包含 HEICO Electronic Technologies Corp.（"HEICO Electronic"）及其子公司，其主要業務為：
•設計與製造電子、微波、電光與其他功率設備、高速介面產品、高壓連接裝置、EMI 以及 RFI 屏蔽與濾波器、高壓先進功率電子、功率轉換產品、水下定位信標、記憶體產品、自密封輔助燃料系統、主動天線系統、空中天線、TSCM 裝置、高可靠性（"Hi-Rel"）電子元件、機上娛樂產品與飛行員顯示器及其他航電元件。

電子科技組（"ETG"） collectively 設計、製造與銷售各種類型的電子、數據與微波、電光產品，包括紅外線模擬與測試設備、雷射測距接收器、電氣電源、備用電源、功率轉換產品、水下定位信標、緊急定位傳輸信標、飛行甲板警示燈、面板、指示器、電磁與無線電頻率幹擾屏蔽與濾波器、高功率電容器充電電源、放大器、行波管放大器、光電探測器、放大器模組、微波功率模組、閃爍燈驅動器、雷射二極體驅動器、弧光燈電源、客製化電源設計、電纜組件、高壓電源、高壓連接裝置與電線、高壓能源產生器、高頻電力傳輸系統；記憶體產品，包括三維微電子與堆疊記憶體、靜態隨機存取記憶體（SRAM）與電子可擦除可程式化只讀記憶體（EEPROM）；惡劣環境電子連接器與其他連接產品、RF 與微波放大器、發射器與接收器與整合組件、子組件與零件；RF 來源、探測器與控制器、無線客艙控制系統、固態電力分配與管理系統、專利客艙電力與娛樂組件與子系統、飛行員顯示器與其他航電組件、抗撞與彈道自密封輔助燃料系統、核子輻射探測器、通訊與電子截獲接收器與調諧器、燃料水平感測系統、高速介面產品用於連接裝置、高性能主動天線系統與空中天線用於商業與軍用飛機、精準導引彈藥、其他防禦應用與商業用途；用於各種嚴苛應用的矽膠材料；高精度電力類比單晶、混合與開放框架組件；高可靠性陶瓷對金屬穿通與連接器、技術監察反制措施（TSC, Technical Surveillance Countermeasures）裝置，用於偵測用於間諜與資訊竊取的裝置；堅固的小型嵌入式計算解決方案；客製高功率濾波器與濾波器組件；用於半導體裝置工程與生產的測試插座與適配器；輻射保證服務與產品；以及高可靠性、複雜、被動電子元件與旋轉接頭組件，主要應用於航空航天與防禦領域，此外還包括其他高階應用，例如醫療與能源用途，包括新興的 "潔淨能源" 與電動化應用。
此外，本公司在財務年度 2025 的營運結果受到近期併購的影響，詳情請參閱財務報表附註第 2 項，即 "併購"。
以下對本公司營運結果與流動性與資本資源的討論與分析，包含財務年度 2025 與財務年度 2024 的比較。與財務年度 2024 相較於財務年度 2023 的類似討論與分析，請參閱本公司財務年度 2024 結束於 10 月 31 日的 10-K 表單中的第 7 項 "管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析"。

headings: 我們可能無法有效執行收購策略，這可能會延緩我們的成長。
來自現有及新進競爭對手的激烈競爭可能對我們的業務造成損害。
無法從供應商處取得特定零組件及原材料可能對我們的業務造成損害。
產品規格成本與要求可能導致我們完成合約的成本增加。
我們可能因天然災害及其他因素而遭受損失或業務中斷，而這些損失可能未被保險所覆蓋。
我們面臨向海外客戶銷售的相關風險，這可能會對我們的業務造成損害。
網路安全事件或其他資訊科技系統的中斷可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
我們可能沒有行政、運營或財務資源來持續推動公司成長。
商譽及其他無形資產佔我們總資產的相當大比例，我們可能永遠無法實現這些無形資產的全部價值。
我們依賴關鍵人員，這些關鍵人員的流失可能對我們的成功產生重大不利影響。
我們的高階管理人員及董事會成員對公司的管理與方向有重大影響力。
我們的成功高度依賴航空產業的表現，而航空產業可能因商業客運需求下降或航空公司機隊變動，導致我們的商品與服務需求下降。
商業飛機的退休或長期停飛可能減少我們的收入，並降低任何相關存貨的價值。
美國及/或外國客戶對防禦、太空或國土安全支出的減少，可能減少我們的收入。
我們面臨因公共衛生威脅而產生的風險，包括全球或區域性的健康危機（"Health Emergencies"）。
稅制變更可能影響我們的有效稅率及未來獲利能力。
我們可能面臨產品責任爭議，且這些爭議可能未完全投保，且此類保險可能無法以商業合理價格取得。
我們可能面臨環境責任，且這些責任可能未被保險覆蓋。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流可能受多項因素影響，許多因素為本公司所無法控制，包括下列因素及其他處於本年度報告表 10-K 中所述因素，任何一項因素均可能導致本公司實際結果與預期結果有重大差異：
本公司策略之關鍵要素為透過收購其他公司來實現成長。本公司之收購策略受多項挑戰與風險影響，包括下列各項：
•合適收購目標之可取得性；Index •資金之可取得性；•管理階層注意力之分散；
•成功整合收購公司之營運與人力；•收購無形資產之潛在減值；
•收購公司之關鍵員工之潛在流失；•使用本公司可動用現金之重大比例；
•透過本公司證券進行收購所導致之股東重大稀釋；•以滿意條件完成收購；
